structured_output.what_is_happening: A Solana token named "Agrippa" was launched straight onto a PumpSwap pool about 13 minutes before detection. It references a real, current story. Around 23 Sep 2026, Mark Zuckerberg's personal AI agent (built inside Meta's Muse) was reported to be called "Agrippa". An "Agrippa" meme coin on the Robinhood chain (0x83a49b...) then went up 30-38x to about $8-9M after Zuckerberg followed its X account. This Solana coin is a cross-chain copy of that story. In its first 12 minutes it recorded about 2,400 buys from 1,934 unique buyers against only 58 unique sellers, about $278k of volume on a $17k market cap, with price up 65%. It has no socials, no website and no DexScreener profile. GMGN counts 44 bundler wallets holding about 19% of traders' share, and the LP is 100% unlocked.

narrative.description: Zuckerberg's AI agent 'Agrippa' (Meta Muse), plus the Robinhood-chain Agrippa meme coin that ran 30-38x after Zuckerberg followed it on X. Robert Harris's novel 'Agrippa' also launched on 24 Sep and adds to the name's visibility.
narrative.why_spreading: A real celebrity/AI hook from 3 days ago with a big multiplier story on another chain. People are copying it across chains. The Solana version's attention seems to come from launch mechanics rather than a new catalyst.

token_connection.why_this_token: It shares the name only. The canonical Agrippa coin is on the Robinhood chain (0x83a49b808f8d5e02cb2931cd2352988f498e5ba3). This Solana token has no links, socials or claimed tie to the story.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Canonical Robinhood-chain Agrippa (about $8M+). An earlier Solana 'AGRIPPA' (BQxAdc...) is dead at a $7k market cap with $0 liquidity. More Solana copies are likely.

authenticity.evidence: 1,934 unique buyers against 58 unique sellers, and about 2,400 buys, in 12 minutes on a $17k-market-cap coin with zero socials. That is not a normal organic pattern; it fits many small buys from bots or distribution wallets. GMGN also flags 44 bundler wallets holding about 19% of the top-trader share. The top 10 holders own only 11.5%, which fits supply being split across many wallets. No X, Reddit or news mention of this contract was found.
authenticity.uncertainty: It could be a real volume-bot campaign that attracts genuine followers because the Agrippa name is fresh. No X data was available.

structural_risks: LP is 100% unlocked on a direct PumpSwap pool (RugCheck flags this as danger)
The creator closed their position; the creator's best previous token peaked at about $138k
It is not the canonical token, and the narrative's main coin sits on another chain
Buy/seller counts look manufactured, so exit liquidity may be thin once the bots stop

structured_output.counterargument: The Agrippa/Zuckerberg story is real, 3 days old, and produced a 30x+ runner. Solana traders often pile into the first liquid Solana copy of a hot cross-chain story. At $17k market cap with $27k of liquidity and heavy buying, a 2x to $35k takes only modest extra demand. Mint and freeze authorities are renounced and holders are widely spread.

structured_output.thesis: Real but 3-day-old narrative whose canonical coin is on another chain. This is an unlinked Solana copy whose early flow looks bot-driven or bundled, with the LP unlocked. The story gives it some chance of catching a wave, but the most likely outcomes are chop and fade, or a pull of liquidity.
